```yaml
name: Release Please

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Release Please
        uses: google-github-actions/release-please-action@v4
        with:
          release-type: python
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          find . -name '*.xml' | wc -l
          echo "No tests present" && true
```
